verification.command: post-merge Phase 2B hard-gate audit and live Intent parity correction
verification.summary: The full planned hard gate exposed two dormant adapter gaps after PR #62 merged: public observed-template variant keys are the existing normalize_option_value aliases of raw PG JSON keys, and payload status=verified was masked by sourceStatus=source_reference. Red-to-green correction tests now cover exact and public keys, alias collision and wrong-item blocking, reused pair deduplication, missing source status fail-closed, both explicit verified status fields, and an eight-source projection bound. 28 loader tests, 87 Phase 1-2B contract tests, 726 current facade/store/backend regressions and 23 Harness/owner/current-state tests passed. A production PG read-only preflight executed the corrected static SQL without deployment and proved Mage/Arcane 15/15 item and variant rows, 15 distinct raw-to-public aliases, no collisions, 1-8 explicit verified sources per item, and no writes. Candidate performance, Resolver/facade and unchanged-runtime gates remain pending.

verification.command: PR #63 first candidate Resolver hard-gate diagnosis and structured item authority correction
verification.summary: Exact first-candidate hashes and built-in runtime smoke passed. The live current Mage/Arcane Authority Context reached 15/15 items and variants with missingFields=[], proving alias/source parity, then the pure Resolver correctly blocked because loader projection omitted existing Battle.net item type facts: finger2/trinket2 inherited finger1/trinket1 only, the two-hand staff lacked handedness, and tier membership setId existed only on the Battle.net tier_set source. Red-to-green correction tests now reuse the existing item type, handedness and equivalent-slot helpers, add generic one-hand weapon hand authority, accept only structured Battle.net tier membership or explicit verified set evidence, and block conflicting set IDs. 35 loader/store tests and six focused facade/runtime-authority tests passed; candidate must be redeployed from the updated PR head before evidence promotion.
